name: resource-small
description: Sequential small resource transfers of varied sizes (20-120 KB, the realistic attachment band) over one link for a fixed wall-time. At these sizes the advertisement, request, and proof round trips dominate over streaming - this measures the per-transfer tax the 1 MiB scenario amortizes away, and brackets where a resource beats windowed link sends.
conformance: settled == received at the far end with byte-identical totals; every transfer hash-proved before it settles
